raw_response: {"diagnosis":"raw_transactions has 28 txn_ids delivered twice, as record_version 1 and a later record_version 2 correction. silver_transactions filters to POSTED without deduplicating, so these appear as duplicates. The fix keeps the latest version per txn_id, ordered by record_version then ingest_ts, and applies the POSTED filter afterwards. That way a txn whose latest version is not POSTED is not resurrected from its older version.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.8,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED'"}}
